[**Friday**]{.underline}

**Research question 2:** Is there an association between number of steps and BMI? Is there any differences in the association among male and female?

Download the synthetic dataset bmi_steps from Canvas. Store it in the directory “data”.

Half of the class uses tables, summary statistics, statistical tests and regression to investigate the research questions. The results should be briefly summarized for the rest of the class.

The other half only uses figures to investigate the research question. Choose a few figures to illustrate your findings to the rest of the class.
